<!doctype html><html lang="de"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>Hütchen-Challenge</title><style>
:root{font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif;color:#fff5dd;background:#120d18}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100dvh;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 12%,#56334a 0%,#251626 42%,#100d17 100%);overflow-x:hidden}.app{max-width:1100px;margin:auto;padding:20px 18px 36px}.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.badge{font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#ffd78c;font-weight:800}.title{font-size:clamp(2rem,6vw,3.5rem);margin:2px 0 0;text-shadow:0 3px 18px #000}.round{background:#332438;border:1px solid #b48b59;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:800}.stage{position:relative;margin-top:18px;min-height:390px;border:3px solid #a77845;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 5%,#715269,#3b2538 52%,#211725 95%);box-shadow:0 25px 55px #0009,inset 0 0 80px #0007}.stage:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 38%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 90px,#ffffff08 90px 94px);opacity:.35}.bulbs{position:absolute;top:12px;left:10px;right:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-around}.bulbs i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffd890;box-shadow:0 0 15px 5px #e9a345a6}.board{position:absolute;bottom:0;height:39%;width:100%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#593321 0 34px,#73472c 35px 38px);border-top:12px solid #bb8951;box-shadow:0 -15px 30px #0006}.message{position:absolute;top:17%;left:15px;right:15px;text-align:center;font-weight:850;font-size:clamp(1rem,3vw,1.5rem);text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000}.cups{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}.cup{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:clamp(48px,12vw,112px);height:125px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;transition:transform .16s,filter .2s;pointer-events:auto;border:0;background:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}.cup .shape{width:90%;height:77%;position:relative;clip-path:polygon(23% 2%,77% 2%,97% 100%,3% 100%);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#511b26 0%,#b5404b 22%,#e9756d 48%,#9b293c 76%,#501925 100%);filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 3px #0009);box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px #0007}.cup .shape:after{content:'✦';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:28%;text-align:center;font-size:27px;color:#ffdd8c;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}.cup .rim{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:100%;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(#f7b96e,#87532c);box-shadow:0 4px 4px #0007}.cup .num{display:none!important}.cup{backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}.cup:disabled{opacity:1}.cup:not(:disabled):active{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px #ffd775)}.cup.active{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #ffe5a8)}.cup:disabled{cursor:default}.ball{position:absolute;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%,#fff8cb,#f6b638 40%,#9c4e12);box-shadow:0 0 20px #ffd456aa;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:left .2s,top .2s;z-index:1}.score{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:16px 0}.player{border:1px solid #9b785a;background:#342438;border-radius:15px;padding:12px;min-width:0}.player.current{border-color:#ffe1a0;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffd67c44}.player .name{font-weight:850;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.player .points{color:#ffd887;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:900}.player small{color:#cbbabf}.controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}.btn{border:1px solid #f1c87d;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(#f9d68e,#d69c47);color:#352118;padding:13px 23px;font-weight:900;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #79512d}.btn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #79512d}.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.muted{color:#d3c4c5;text-align:center;line-height:1.5}.setup{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.setup select{background:#3c2b42;color:white;padding:11px;border:1px solid #c69c6c;border-radius:10px;font-size:1rem}.result{text-align:center;background:#31233a;border:1px solid #bd9259;border-radius:15px;padding:18px;margin-top:12px}.hide{display:none!important}@media(max-width:600px){.stage{min-height:335px}.cup{height:96px}.score{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.app{padding:12px}.cup .shape:after{font-size:19px}}
